coverage.population: Three recorded-vote categories for appointment of 40 Independent International Scientific Panel on AI members on 12 February 2026
coverage.included: 3 populated records; Three recorded-vote categories for appointment of 40 Independent International Scientific Panel on AI members on 12 February 2026
coverage.omitted: Population represented, country-by-country affirmative list, unrecorded members, regulatory power and current panel outputs
coverage.missingness: Unlisted entities are missing, not zero.

uncertainty: A single procedural vote is not a measure of influence in international AI rulemaking. Panel members act in individual capacity; the panel synthesises science and is not a world regulator.

transform.description: Manual transcription of factual values/categories; no interpolation, imputation or causal inference.
transform.validation: Each row carries a source locator; categorical values separately label plans, policies and observed events.

verification.method: Read primary source and compare each extracted record to its named source location.

scoring.reason: No universal extremity or impact score is supported by these data.

forecast.reason: No validated forecast was supplied. Policy intentions and planned installations are not predictions.
